jobs.title: Senior Product Manager / Product Manager
jobs.description:
Overview
Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world.

We are looking for Product Managers passionate about building customer-centric security products and experiences. In this role, you will help define product vision and strategy, collaborate closely with engineering and design teams, engage directly with customers, and deliver solutions that solve complex security and identity challenges at enterprise scale. Our teams are building the next generation of security capabilities across identity, governance, access management, risk management, compliance, security operations, and emerging technologies. You will have the opportunity to shape products that serve millions of users worldwide while working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

#MSFTSecurity, #MSFTSecurity

Responsibilities
•    Define and drive product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for security and identity-related products and services.
•    Partner closely with engineering, design, research, data science, and business stakeholders to deliver innovative customer-facing solutions.
•    Engage customers and partners to understand needs, validate scenarios, gather feedback, and inform product decisions.
•    Translate customer, market, and business opportunities into clear product requirements and execution plans.
•    Drive alignment across cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders to achieve shared outcomes.
•    Prioritize investments and features based on customer impact, business value, technical feasibility, and strategic goals.
•    Define success metrics, monitor product performance, and communicate results and impact to leadership.
•    Support go-to-market efforts by partnering with marketing, sales, and business teams to drive adoption and customer success.
•    Identify emerging trends, opportunities, and challenges across security, identity, governance, compliance, access management, and related technology domains.
•    Foster a culture of innovation, customer obsession, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's Degree AND 2+ years experience in product/service/project/program management or software development - OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years of experience in product management, program management, software development, or a related technical field - OR equivalent experience.

- Experience delivering customer-facing products in partnership with engineering teams.
- Strong product strategy, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
- Experience translating customer needs into product decisions and execution.
- Knowledge of identity, security, governance, compliance, cloud security, or Microsoft Security/Entra technologies.
- End-to-end UX experience
- AI-native PM experience

Do you want to build cutting-edge AI solutions that empower organizations to automate complex business processes, create intelligent agents, and deliver exceptional end-to-end customer experiences?
The Copilot Studio and Contact Center team is on a mission to redefine enterprise engagement through rich, omnichannel AI agents, conversational workflows, and next-generation service experiences. We are building the platform that enables organizations to design, deploy, and scale intelligent solutions across customer support, business operations, and employee productivity scenarios.
We are seeking a talented Senior Product Managers and Principal Product Managers (multiple positions) who can deeply understand customer and business needs, translate those insights into compelling product experiences, and define functional requirements that solve real-world problems with Generative AI. In this role, you will collaborate closely with engineering, design, research, and partner teams to drive product strategy and execution from concept to delivery.
You will help shape experiences that enable makers to build powerful AI agents while ensuring those capabilities are seamlessly delivered to end users. Your work will empower customer service representatives to be more productive, help business leaders optimize operational efficiency, and enable organizations to automate and scale critical workflows.
This role offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of AI innovation, leveraging the latest advancements in foundation models, multimodal experiences, agentic systems, and AI-powered tooling to solve meaningful customer challenges at enterprise scale. If you are excited about combining customer obsession, product thinking, and cutting-edge AI technologies to create transformative experiences, we'd love to hear from you.

- Drive competitive evaluation of the ecosystem, staying ahead of the curve for latest advancements, adopting current solutions to new capabilities.
- Lead and coach a team of product managers to achieve key business goals for Copilot Studio.
- Build inclusive team culture and be the champion to advocate for core Microsoft values.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Content Product
jobs.location: United States, California, Mountain View; United States, Washington, Redmond
jobs.description:
Overview
Microsoft AI is reimagining how billions of people discover, understand, and act on content. Our Content Product Experiences team builds experiences across MSN, the Edge new tab, Windows Start, and Copilot Discover, from personalized feeds to entirely new AI-native products. We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to identify and build the next generation of content products and the reusable intelligence systems that power them. You will take new ideas from early exploration through product-market fit, beginning with personalized company and industry intelligence for enterprise information workers. You will bring together user understanding, knowledge, content agents, ranking, and interactive experiences to help people understand what changed, why it matters, and what to do next. This is a highly cross-functional role for a category builder who can see around corners, prototype quickly, and turn emerging AI capabilities into products people depend on.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

Responsibilities
- Own the vision and strategy for new content intelligence products, identifying unmet customer needs and technology shifts that can define our next product categories.
- Build enterprise content intelligence as the first product focus, including personalized company and industry briefings, watchlists, and experiences that explain what changed, why it matters, and what a user can do next.
- Translate capabilities across user understanding, knowledge graphs, content agents, ranking, quality, and interactive components into coherent, reusable product systems that can serve multiple Microsoft canvases.
- Lead rapid customer discovery, prototyping, and experimentation to find product-market fit, separate durable value from novelty, and earn the right to scale.
- Partner deeply with design, engineering, applied science, editorial, and canvas product teams to integrate new products into Edge, Windows, MSN, and Copilot without duplicating existing ownership.
- Establish clear success criteria, use evidence to decide what to advance, refine, or stop, and transition proven experiences to the teams best positioned to operate them at scale.
- Act as a force multiplier for the product organization by raising the bar for zero-to-one product thinking, mentoring PMs, and influencing senior leaders across organizational boundaries.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree AND 10+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development - OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree AND 15+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development - OR equivalent experience.

- Proven track record of taking ambiguous, zero-to-one product ideas from customer discovery through launch and measurable adoption. (required)
- Experience defining and shipping AI, machine learning, search, recommendation, knowledge, or data-intensive product experiences. (required)
- Experience leading large cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders without formal authority.
- Experience building enterprise intelligence, knowledge, content, or productivity products that serve multiple applications or customer experiences.
- Demonstrated ability to develop multiple new product opportunities, make disciplined evidence-based decisions, and transition successful products from exploration to scaled execution.
- A builder's portfolio with concrete examples of new products or categories created using emerging technology.
- A solid point of view on how AI will change content discovery, understanding, and action.
- Comfort operating across capability, product, and experience boundaries while maintaining clear ownership.
- Customer obsession, intellectual curiosity, a bias to prototype, and excellent judgment about when to scale, pivot, or stop.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager/JV General Manager
jobs.description:
Overview
We are seeking an experienced business and product leader to serve as General Manager of Microsoft Mobile Alliance Internet Services Co., Ltd. (MMAIS), Microsoft's Joint Venture (JV) company in China.
MMAIS plays a critical role in enabling Microsoft's Search business in China by operating the licensed entity that supports Bing China services, regulatory compliance, content moderation operations, datacenter operations, government-facing obligations, and other locally hosted online services. MMAIS operates under a unique governance and regulatory model and serves as a strategic bridge between Microsoft, regulatory stakeholders, business partners, and operational teams.
In addition to leading MMAIS, this role will own key Search product management initiatives in the region, including driving Bing growth opportunities in CJK markets and leading China AI Landing efforts to bring AI-powered Search experiences to market in compliance with local regulations.
This role requires a unique combination of executive leadership, business operations excellence, regulatory acumen, and product management expertise.

Responsibilities
MMAIS General Management
- Provide overall leadership and strategic direction for MMAIS operations and business performance.
- Serve as the primary executive accountable for MMAIS governance, operational excellence, compliance, and business outcomes.
- Partner closely with Microsoft leadership, CELA, Finance, HR, Procurement, and external stakeholders to ensure effective operation of the JV.
- Manage relationships with government agencies, regulators, JV partners, and other key external stakeholders.
- Oversee maintenance of critical licenses, including ICP and other regulatory approvals required to operate Microsoft online services in China.
- Ensure high-quality execution of content moderation, compliance operations, and regulatory response processes.
- Drive operational excellence across infrastructure, datacenter operations, vendor management, procurement, finance, and workforce planning.
- Lead organizational planning, budgeting, and operational reviews to ensure sustainable and efficient business operations.
- Act as the escalation point for critical regulatory, operational, and business risks.

CJK Search Product Management
- Own and drive Search growth strategy for CJK markets.
- Identify opportunities to increase Bing adoption, engagement, and usage across priority markets.
- Lead China AI Landing initiatives and collaborate with global and regional teams to bring AI-powered Search experiences into the China market.
- Define product strategy, roadmap, business requirements, and success metrics for regional Search initiatives.
- Partner with engineering, data science, marketing, business development, and compliance teams to execute product priorities.
- Evaluate competitive trends, market opportunities, user needs, and AI innovations to influence product direction.
- Represent regional customer and market requirements within the broader Search organization.

Leadership
- Build alignment across diverse stakeholders and functions.
- Drive accountability and execution across complex cross-functional initiatives.
- Communicate effectively with senior executives, government representatives, business partners, and employees.
- Foster a culture of compliance, operational excellence, customer obsession, and business impact.

Qualifications
Required
- Significant leadership experience managing complex business operations, preferably in highly regulated industries or environments.
- Strong executive presence and exceptional communication skills with demonstrated ability to engage senior leaders, government agencies, and external partners.
- Proven track record of driving business performance and operational excellence.
- Experience leading large-scale cross-functional initiatives with measurable business impact.
- Deep understanding of product management fundamentals, including strategy, customer insight, prioritization, roadmap planning, and execution.
- Strong analytical and business judgment skills.
- Ability to navigate ambiguity and influence across organizational boundaries.

Preferred
- Experience in Search, AI, Internet, or cloud-based products.
- Strong understanding of generative AI products and emerging AI ecosystem trends.
- Familiarity with China's regulatory environment for online services and AI products.
- Experience working with international and cross-cultural teams.
- Prior General Manager, business leader, or senior product leadership experience.

jobs.description:

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As AI agents become part of how the world works, that empowerment increasingly depends on trust. These agents are only as efficient and reliable as the tools made available to them. As organizations connect agents to a fast-growing ecosystem of MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, plugins, skills, connectors, and custom integrations, the ability to onboard, discover, and govern those tools becomes essential to enterprise trust. Today this is a fragmented and fast-emerging space. We're looking for a leader who can bring coherence to this tool's governance story.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the tool governance experience in Agent 365, the product that lets customers inventory, register tools, discover unsanctioned ones, and apply consistent policy and controls across them. You will turn a  fast-emerging space into a coherent governance value and ship these capabilities that make agent tooling safe for regulated and sovereign customers.

This is a high-ownership, high-ambiguity role at the center of how enterprises adopt agents with confidence. You'll partner across engineering, design, security, and compliance to define the strategy, shape the roadmap, and deliver experiences that set the standard for trustworthy agent tooling.

Microsoft's culture is grounded in a growth mindset, and we bring our all each day to build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
• Own the strategy and roadmap for tool onboarding and governance, including registry experience for plugins, skills, connectors, and customer-supplied tool packages.
• Engage with customers to understand governance and compliance requirements and translate them into clear, prioritized product investments.
• Define granular governance controls for agent tools
• Deliver discovery and observability for unsanctioned/Shadow AI tools, giving customers visibility into tools operating outside sanctioned channels, along with usage and activity insights.
• Build governance capabilities for regulated and sovereign environments, including support for government cloud and runtime audit evidence for legal, security, and compliance stakeholders.
• Partner closely with the different product teams within Microsoft to have coherent tool governance and security solutions with a seamless and engaging experience.

- Familiarity with the AI tooling ecosystem (agent extensibility, plugins, and connectors) or adjacent platform-governance domains.

Microsoft Foundry is redefining model-forward development with new UI/UX patterns, runtimes to build agents, orchestrating across multiple agents, and a reimagined management and observability layer.

Overview
The Windows + Devices Fundamentals team builds and operates data platforms and backend services that help teams improve Windows performance, power efficiency, and reliability. We connect signals from labs and the installed base to trustworthy metrics, actionable diagnostics, and measurable improvements in responsiveness, battery life, memory efficiency, and device health.
We are looking for a Product Manager II to own a data and services product area, from understanding the problem through delivery, adoption, and improvement. You will work closely with engineering, data science, and partner PMs to make data trustworthy, services useful, and insights actionable. This role combines hands-on analysis with product ownership: asking the right questions, defining clear requirements, and following through until the work makes a measurable difference.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
- Own a feature area: Understand the needs of teams using our data and services. Define problem statements, requirements, success measures, and acceptance criteria; prioritize the backlog within the team's broader roadmap.
- Measurement and analysis: Define scoped metrics, queries, baselines, and cohorts. Use SQL/KQL to investigate product-health movements; work with data science and engineering to understand statistical uncertainty and separate customer regressions from data or population changes.
- Improve data quality: Partner with engineering on instrumentation, schemas, and ingestion-to-consumption pipeline requirements. Define checks for completeness, correctness, freshness, and schema changes; incorporate privacy and security needs into the feature plan.

- Learn from operation: Track adoption, data quality, and service health after release. Use partner feedback and operational findings to prioritize improvements in usability, reliability, latency, and cost.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Overview
Microsoft 365 carries a large share of the world's business communication, and almost none of it reaches a mailbox without passing through Substrate Transport. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own a core area of that pipeline: to set its direction, define what we build, and carry the work through to an outcome that customers and the business can measure.
This role suits someone comfortable with depth. The problems are technical, the systems are hyper scale and long-lived, and the right answer usually depends on evidence you go and find yourself. In return you get genuine ownership of a service every Microsoft 365 customer depends on, and a team that expects you to lead rather than coordinate.
Substrate Transport is the engine that routes, filters, and delivers the messages that flow through Microsoft 365. Our mission is to move mail reliably, safely, and efficiently at planetary scale, and to give the workloads built on the platform they can depend on without having to reason about the plumbing underneath.
The team's scope follows the full path a message takes: submission and ingestion, routing and categorization, policy and compliance enforcement, hygiene and anti-abuse controls, and final delivery to a mailbox or an external destination. It also covers the connector and hybrid surfaces that customers configure themselves, the volumetric and throttling controls that keep the service healthy under load, and the continued modernization of infrastructure that predates the cloud era.
This position is based at the Redmond campus with 3 days per week work in the office and 2 days per week work from home. Domestic relocation assistance is available.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
You will own a focus area within the transport pipeline from definition through shipped outcome, working alongside engineering leads, partner PM teams across Exchange Online and Microsoft 365, and the service engineers who keep mail flowing every day.
Define the product
Set the strategy and roadmap for your area of the pipeline, grounded in customer promises rather than in a feature list. Write the specs that engineering builds from, state the hypothesis each investment is testing, and say plainly how you will know whether it worked.
Align the business and technical strategy for the area, including how it fits the broader Substrate and Microsoft 365 direction, and make the trade-offs between short-term relief and the long-term architecture the service needs.
Drive execution
Run your area through the full engineering lifecycle: scope, safe rollout, telemetry, and the operational readiness a service of this size demands. Anticipate the dependency that will slip before it slips, and hold a mitigation ready when it does.
Carry security, privacy, compliance, and accessibility obligations as part of the definition of done rather than as a late review gate, and make sure changes to mail flow are validated before they reach customers at scale.
Own the outcome
Own one or more service or business metrics for your area and build the roadmap that moves them. Go directly to the telemetry, message traces, and large-scale data the service produces, and use both the quantitative and the qualitative signal to frame the problem before proposing a solution.
Represent the area to leadership, to partner teams, and to customers, simplifying a complex system enough for a decision to be made without flattening the detail that matters.
Lead the team around you
Raise the bar for how the team works: sharpen other people's specs with real feedback, mentor less experienced product managers, and establish patterns your teammates choose to copy because they make the work go faster.
Resolve problems that need cross-organizational alignment, securing commitment from teams that do not report to you and that may not share your goals.

Qualifications
Required/minimum qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development - OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements:

- Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

- 2+ years experience taking a product, feature, or experience to market (e.g., design, addressing product market fit, and launch, internal tool/framework).
- 4+ years experience improving product metrics for a product, feature, or experience in a market (e.g., growing customer base, expanding customer usage, avoiding customer churn).
- 4+ years experience disrupting a market for a product, feature, or experience (e.g., competitive disruption, taking the place of an established competing product).
- Five or more years in product management, or equivalent experience in engineering, systems, or technical program management with direct ownership of a product area.
- A track record of taking a technical product or service area from definition through a shipped, measured outcome.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
Overview
The base model gets you capability. Post-training is what turns that capability into a model people actually want to use; one that follows instructions well, has the right tone and judgment for Copilot's surfaces, refuses the right things, and keeps getting better release over release.
We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to sit inside that process. You'll be embedded directly with applied researchers and ML engineers running RLHF, fine-tuning, and preference-tuning pipelines, reading model outputs, calling out what's wrong, and turning that into concrete training priorities. You're the person who brings the end user's voice into a room that's otherwise all metrics and loss curves.
This is a technical, hands-on PM role, not just a roadmap-and-requirements role. You'll spend real time in transcripts and eval dashboards, and you'll need enough grounding in how post-training actually works (RLHF, DPO/preference optimization, instruction tuning, data curation) to have a credible point of view with the research team.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
- Embed in the post-training loop : work day-to-day with research and applied ML teams during fine-tuning and RLHF cycles, reviewing model outputs and giving structured feedback on quality, tone, and behavior

- Define what "good" means for Copilot's models : set the priorities for capability, personality, and safety tradeoffs across surfaces (Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, Windows) — where "good" is often genuinely ambiguous and hasn't been decided before

- Run RLHF/preference data campaigns : partner with data and labeling teams to scope what human preference data gets collected, for which behaviors, and why

- Build and maintain behavior evals : translate qualitative judgment calls ("this response felt too hedgy," "this refused when it shouldn't have") into evaluation sets that can be tracked release over release

- Own the feedback loop : turn user research, enterprise customer feedback, and production incident learnings into concrete post-training priorities — closing the gap between "users are unhappy with X" and "the next fine-tune addresses X"

- Make the tuning tradeoffs explicit : helpfulness vs. caution, consistency vs. personality, latency/cost vs. quality — and drive alignment across research, safety, and product leadership on where the line sits

- Represent Responsible AI and enterprise requirements into training priorities — compliance behaviors, refusal policies, and brand voice all have to be reflected in what the model is actually tuned to do.

jobs.description:
Overview
Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world.
Microsoft PKI Services (MPS) provides the trust infrastructure that enables secure communications across Microsoft’s cloud platforms and services. MPS designs, builds, and operates publicly trusted Certificate Authorities (CAs) that issue and manage digital certificates used to authenticate services, establish encrypted communications, and protect data for Microsoft and millions of customers worldwide. The team is responsible for the full lifecycle of Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) operations, including certificate issuance, key management, revocation, incident response, auditing, and adherence to globally recognized trust requirements. MSPKI operates in a highly transparent and externally governed environment, where compliance with browser root programs, industry standards, and public reporting expectations is required to maintain trust in Microsoft’s services.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
- Own MPS compliance with global public trust requirements to ensure the continued trustworthiness of Microsoft's public CAs.
- Define and execute Microsoft’s PKI long term compliance strategy including alignment with evolving browser root program policies, audit frameworks (e.g., WebTrust), and emerging industry requirements.
- Lead external incident response and reporting for compliance incidents involving Microsoft's public CAs including coordinating engagement with root programs, auditors, and industry stakeholders.
- Serve as Microsoft’s primary technical representative to the CA/Browser Forum and related groups.
- Drive standards advancement to improve global Internet trust.

Embody our  culture  and  values

- Background in applied cryptography, security engineering, identity infrastructure, or internet-scale security operations.
- Experience navigating or leading response to publicly disclosed compliance or operational incidents.

The  Intelligent Conversation and Communications Cloud (IC3)  is the core communications platform that powers Microsoft Teams — delivering reliable, high-quality audio/video calling, meetings, chat, and presence to millions of users and organizations around the world. You'll partner closely with engineering leaders, platform teams, and the engineers who use these tools to identify the highest-leverage investments and see them through to adoption and impact.

jobs.description:
Overview
With the pace of AI innovation and competition, it's more important than ever to ensure that these experiences are safe and secure. Come join the team in Microsoft Office that hundreds of millions of users rely on for secure, private, and responsible use of AI productivity.

Our agents now read from documents, tools, connectors, and the open web, and any of that content could be crafted by an attacker to hijack what the agent does next. The Office Security Team is looking for a  Senior Product Manager to own the layer that stops malicious instructions from ever landing, the detection that catches them on the way in, and the containment that makes sure a single bad input cannot cascade into real damage. Cross-prompt injection, or XPIA, is the defining security threat of the agentic era, and there is no textbook for beating it.
The defenses you ship decide whether people can trust AI with their most sensitive work, from their finances to their health records to their company's crown jewels. This is a place to go deep: the detection and containment problems here are genuinely unsolved, the feedback loop is fast, and the craft you build will be in demand for the rest of the agentic era. pre-AI era, and influence peers to embed AI into the fabric of how we work.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
This role is for a problem-solver who is energized by hard, unmapped challenges. You will likely see yourself in most of the following.
- You go deep on security and systems problems, and an unsolved threat energizes you rather than deterring you.

- You are driven by real customer impact, and you seek out the attack scenarios and stakes that make the work matter.

- You turn ambiguity into a plan, owning strategy, roadmap, and crisp execution across many partner teams.

- You design guardrails that protect people without getting in their way, balancing security with a great user experience.

- You build trust and momentum across groups, and you ship results others can build on.

- You operate independently with a strong get-it-done bias when the path is unclear.

- You communicate with clarity and conviction, in writing and in the room.

Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications:

- A track record of using metrics and telemetry to prove and improve real-world security posture.
- Experience designing user-facing trust, consent, or safety experiences is a plus.

- Familiarity with LLMs, AI, and agentic worklfows; demonstrated use of AI in daily work that improve efficiency, productivity, success outcomes.
- Self-driven technical curiosity and unafraid to try something new or ambiguous.

Microsoft's transition to quantum-safe cryptography is a company-wide, multi-year change spanning encryption in transit, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and encryption at rest. Success requires more than publishing standards or building foundational components. Microsoft needs a reliable way to measure adoption, expose gaps, assign accountability, and drive decisions across organizations that own their own roadmaps. Key Management is a critical product area in the transition. Quantum-safe outcomes depend on the readiness of key-management services, key hierarchies, Hardware Security Modules (HSM) hardware and firmware, and related compliance dependencies.

As a Principal Product Manager for Post-Quantum Cryptography ( PQC) Adoption & Key Management, you will define what readiness means, what Microsoft measures, and how leaders act on the evidence. You will work closely with the Key Management team on its PQC product strategy and roadmap, while using that product work as a proving ground for the broader adoption model. Your job is to make the transition concrete: clear requirements, measurable progress, explicit owners, sequenced dependencies, and credible commitments to leadership, customers, and regulators.

The AI Monetization Product Team within the AI Experiences organizattion at Microsoft is responsible for building and scaling advertising, commerce, and revenue-generating experiences across Microsoft's AI and consumer ecosystem. Sales, Finance, Product, and leadership teams rely on trusted reporting to understand revenue performance, product adoption, customer value, forecasting, and the health of the business. Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. Our services protect millions of keys, secrets, and certificates across every Azure region and sovereign cloud, enabling customers and internal teams to build zero-trust architectures without ever handling raw credentials. We sit at the intersection of identity, security, and platform — which means our work touches everything from Security compliance mandates and credential theft mitigation to the cryptographic underpinnings of Azure's most regulated workloads. If you want to work on infrastructure that is both foundational and existentially important to the security posture of one of the world's largest cloud platforms, this is the team.

By bringing Microsoft’s 1P agents into a consistent management model first, Agent 365 establishes the standards, capabilities, and customer expectations required to accelerate enterprise adoption, strengthen trust in agentic AI, and extend the value of Microsoft’s security, identity, compliance, and productivity ecosystem.

The Defender for Office 365 product group owns the protection experience for email and collaboration across Microsoft 365.
The product management team drives end-to-end ownership across the product lifecycle, partnering with groups and stakeholders across the organization and directly with customers and partners.
As part of Microsoft XDR, the product spans real-time detection, post-delivery response and recovery, investigation and hunting, and pre-breach capabilities.
The team owns one of the largest security solutions in the XDR portfolio and helps shape how communication and productivity security will work in an era of AI-powered social engineering, using AI to strengthen detection and making MDO the trusted entry point into the broader Defender suite.
The group works at the intersection of protection efficacy, explainability and everyday usability, serving SOC analysts, email administrators and end users alike. Product and engineering are located in IDC and ILDC, as part of the Defender global team.

Responsibilities
Product Manager — Microsoft Defender for Office 365
Are you a product manager who wants to own a product that protects organizations every single day Are you ready to work where security, AI and everyday productivity tools meet Come work with us at the largest security company in the world, on one of its most broadly deployed products.
Microsoft Defender for Office 365 protects email and collaboration across Microsoft 365. It is part of the Microsoft XDR portfolio, delivering real-time detection, post-delivery response and recovery, investigation and hunting for SOC analysts and email administrators, along with pre-breach posture and risk reduction. Attackers are shifting from recognizable malicious artifacts toward adaptive, multi-step social engineering and our job is to stay ahead of that shift while keeping protection explainable and operable at enterprise scale.
We are a diverse group of product managers, software engineers and security researchers building for customers that include the largest organizations in the world. Analyze customer and market signals, telemetry and support data to identify unmet needs and opportunities in your area. Evaluate trade-offs and prioritize with your cross-functional partners.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Microsoft 365 Network Platform
jobs.description:
Overview
Every request Microsoft 365 serves depends on the network beneath it — a global fabric spanning every geography Microsoft operates in, serving hundreds of millions of people. As Microsoft 365 grows and its infrastructure continues to move toward an Azure-native footprint, the network has to evolve with it: toward explicit, identity-aware connectivity, stronger regional isolation, and smaller failure domains.We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own network connectivity strategy for the platform. That evolution is where you would start, and the charter continues well past it. You will shape long-term architecture direction with the teams that own and depend on the network.This is an AI-first product management role. AI is changing what the PM role consists of, and that change is accelerating. We expect someone who already works this way, or is eager to, and who brings the team with them.This role requires on-call for the platform. The network sits on the critical path for Microsoft 365, and product management here comes with real operational ownership — including occasional out-of-hours engagement during live incidents.This position is based in Redmond, Washington and requires the employee be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week.Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
- Own the strategy for network connectivity and its evolution across the platform, and turn that direction into a roadmap teams can execute.
- Drive the move to an explicit, regionalized, policy-enforced connectivity model — including the migration sequencing, exception governance, and dependency burn-down that make it real.
- Take on high-impact problems across the charter, including scalability, resiliency, segmentation and isolation, capacity, latency, and platform transitions, and drive them to resolution.
- Work problems end-to-end: own the outcome even when every step of the work belongs to someone else.
- Model the tradeoffs before committing investment, and apply judgment where the model runs out.
- Weigh security, reliability, performance, and cost against each other, and prioritize multi-year platform investments with the teams that fund and build them.
- Keep failure domains contained and recovery paths intact.Participate in the on-call rotation — help scope and triage live incidents, and turn what you learn from them into root-cause fixes and roadmap priorities.
- Set success metrics, OKRs (Objectives and Key Results), and KPIs (key performance indicators), and shape investment priorities with leadership.
- Explain complex tradeoffs to executives in a way that leads to decisions.
- Mentor other product managers and move the team toward better, AI-forward ways of working.

Qualifications
Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years experience in product management and driving a large-scale infrastructure migration or network transition for large scale distributed systems - OR equivalent experience.

- Decision Making - The ability to make decisions in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment. This includes the ability to define, diagnose, and determine an appropriate resolution, recommendation, or decision while considering alternatives and factors (e.g., resources, costs, tradeoffs).
- Influence Others - The ability to garner support for initiatives by gaining the respect of others and inspiring trust and confidence.
- Negotiation - The ability to achieve mutually satisfying agreements in negotiations with others by listening to their objectives, acting as the company's representative to effectively communicate the company's objective, and seeking common ground and collaborative solutions.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Technical depth in networking and large-scale distributed systems — enough to reason with architects about how traffic moves, how the network fails, and what it costs; to hold your own in a live incident; and to explain those tradeoffs clearly to any audience.
- Includes cloud networking — virtual networks and peering, software-defined networking, address management, and NAT — and how their limits behave at fleet scale.
- Experience driving a large-scale infrastructure migration or network transition on a live, high-availability service — including sequencing, rollback, and dependency burn-down.
- Fluency with AI-forward ways of working (agents, automation, evaluation sets), or a demonstrated ability to adopt new tooling quickly.
- Working knowledge of Layer-7 routing, reverse proxies, or front-door/CDN-class infrastructure.
- Zero-trust and network security fundamentals — segmentation, identity-based authorization, mutual TLS, and policy enforcement.
- Experience with Microsoft 365, Exchange, Azure infrastructure, or other large multi-tenant platforms — helpful but not required; the platform specifics can be learned.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Overview
The next decade of computing will be defined by a simple challenge: demand for compute will outpace supply.
As AI agents, Copilots, and intelligent services become foundational to every product, the traditional approaches to capacity management break down. Human-driven planning, static quotas, and manual scaling decisions cannot keep pace with the speed and complexity of modern cloud systems.
At Microsoft 365 Core, we are reimagining how hyperscale platforms operate in a world of constrained resources. Our vision is a future where intelligent systems continuously optimize infrastructure, dynamically allocate capacity, and help services scale up, scale down, and adapt in real time without requiring customers to become infrastructure experts.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the future of compute efficiency, workload elasticity, and intelligent capacity management for COSMIC, Microsoft's cloud-native platform powering some of the largest Microsoft 365 services and next-generation AI workloads.
This role is not about incremental improvements to existing infrastructure. It is about defining how millions of cores of compute are managed in an age of AI. You will shape the strategy for evictable compute, workload mobility, intelligent scaling, and agent-driven capacity optimization. You will partner across Microsoft 365 and Azure to build systems that maximize efficiency while ensuring critical services remain reliable, performant, and cost-effective.
If you are excited about solving some of the hardest infrastructure challenges in the industry and defining how intelligent platforms operate at hyperscale, we'd love to talk to you.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

Responsibilities
The work in this role is wide-ranging and will involve:
- Define the strategy for evictable compute and intelligent workload placement across one of the largest cloud platforms in the world.

- Reimagine capacity management for the AI era, moving from human-driven decisions to agent-assisted and autonomous optimization systems.

- Build platform capabilities that automatically scale, rebalance, migrate, and reclaim compute resources while minimizing customer effort.

- Develop new operating models that maximize utilization of constrained infrastructure and unlock greater efficiency across Microsoft 365 workloads.

- Partner with Azure, Microsoft 365, and others to turn capacity from a fixed constraint into a dynamic, software-defined resource.

- Drive the long-term vision for autonomous platform operations where intelligent agents continuously optimize fleet and workload efficiency, cost, and scalability.

- Influence senior leaders across Microsoft on the future of hyperscale infrastructure, capacity allocation, elasticity, and cloud efficiency.

- Create experiences that allow customers to focus on their business outcomes while the platform intelligently manages the complexity of scaling.

- Embody our  Culture  and  Values

- 2+ years experience taking a product, feature, or experience to market (e.g., design, addressing product market fit, and launch, internal tool/framework).
- 4+ years experience improving product metrics for a product, feature, or experience in a market (e.g., growing customer base, expanding customer usage, avoiding customer churn).
- 4+ years experience disrupting a market for a product, feature, or experience (e.g., competitive disruption, taking the place of an established competing product).
- 2+ years of familiarity with Kubernetes or Containers.
- Excellent written and verbal communication/presentation skills through all levels of the organization, technical and non-technical.
- Innate curiosity and ability to thrive in ambiguous situations as you work to bring clarity to those around you.
- Individuals with a positive, collaborative, can-do attitude and bias for action.
- Cultural activators, who place a high priority on a healthy team culture and contribute to that culture themselves.
- Critical thinking, intellectual curiosity, a strong history of solving complex problems and the ability to thrive in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.
- Understanding or experience with building software platforms and of the software development process.
- Strong empathy for developers and working backwards from customers.

Work IQ is Microsoft 365 Copilot’s workplace intelligence layer , enabling AI agents and experiences to securely reason over enterprise data such as emails, meetings, documents, Teams messages, and people signals. Work IQ exposes this intelligence through agent-first APIs, including the Work IQ API, CLI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, while respecting Microsoft Graph permissions, tenant policies, and compliance boundaries.
We, the M365 Core Asia Pacific Copilot extensibility engineering team, are looking for a Principal Product Manager for Work IQ whose primary product focus is evaluation — the load-bearing quality gate of the Work IQ agent developer lifecycle. Evaluation is where an agent earns the right to ship: it spans the committed eval suite and its correspondence to the success criteria declared at scoping, measurement across quality, accuracy, latency, cost, trust, DLP behavior, and source scoping, failure triage against the response playbook, and the advisory-board sign-off that governs what customers actually receive. Our AI team sits within ES365 (Microsoft 365 Engineering Systems), and we own the Agentic Engineering platform being adopted across all of Microsoft. ES365 owns the tools and systems used by thousands of Microsoft developers who innovate across the company's largest codebases, from source control and check-in experience to build, validation, and deployment automation. jobs.description:
Overview
The Windows Enterprise and Security (ENS) team is building a new product and engineering presence in Microsoft's India Development Center (IDC) to deliver the foundational Windows capabilities that enterprises depend on every day.
TPM(Trusted Platform Module) is how millions of Windows users securely store biometric data (like fingerprints or facial recognition) and PINs, providing a secure and convenient way to sign into Windows without having to use a password. TPM technology helps organizations establish a tamper resistant, hardware root of trust that’s at the hear of computing confidential data as well as establishing consistent security access and control.
As the Principal Product Manager for TPM/Attestation, you will drive product strategy and execution for the Windows TPM stack in partnership with internal and external partners such as hardware, OEM vendors, Microsoft cloud services like Intune, Azure Attestation and Azure Entra. You will engage directly with enterprise IT admins and IT leadership, and translate customer needs into roadmap and feature decisions spanning the Windows client, services, and cloud control plane.
This is an individual-contributor role based in Bangalore alongside the broader ENS IDC team.
Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

- Drive the product roadmap and execution for the Windows TPM platform and Azure attestation stack, including the enrollment, credential storage, firmware upgrades, TPM deployment scenarios as Pluton as well as discrete chips.
- Driving relationships, alignment and delivery across internal partners as well as external Hardware/OEM partners.
- Partner with Software Engineering across client, service, and cloud control plane teams to design and ship end-to-end enterprise scenarios (onboarding to policy to compliance to remediation).

- Bachelor's Degree AND 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development.  - OR equivalent experience.

- 5+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
- Experience defining and shipping enterprise software, manageability, device management, or platform capabilities.

- Hands-on experience with Windows TPM, Attestation, MDM, Group Policy, provisioning, update/compliance flows, Autopilot, or Intune (or an equivalent MDM platform).

jobs.title: Principal Product Strategist, Commerce
jobs.description:
Overview
Microsoft Commerce is placing large bets across Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments in a market being reshaped by agentic commerce and a live contest over the protocols and payer models that will govern it.
We are looking for a Principal Product Strategist, Commerce  to own the analytical and narrative spine of Commerce strategy: the person who can look across the whole agentic-commerce field and our position in it, size the opportunity, name the bet, and prove the business model works — then write it so it lands in the room.
This is an individual-contributor force-multiplier to the VP. The role sets net-new strategic direction that the pillar teams build against, holds the entire Commerce picture at once, and reaches a defensible call: what we bet on, who pays and why, how big the prize is, and the story that carries it through review. The ideal candidate reasons from first principles about business models and market opportunity, brings structure to high-stakes product decisions, and turns dense analysis into one clear, defensible narrative. Leverage comes from the quality of the thinking and the clarity of the call rather than the size of a team.
In this role you will own strategy across the full Commerce portfolio, including:
- Market & competitive strategy: a first-principles POV on agentic commerce — the protocol landscape, the incentives of each major player, and where our advantage is real.
- Monetization & business-model design: who pays and why across Consumer, Merchant, and Partner; payer models, methods, and sequencing that give the strategy a working economic engine.
- Opportunity sizing & forecasting: market, feature, and monetization sizing from first principles — TAM → SAM → capturable, unit economics, ARR and ROI.
- Decision frameworks for major bets: structure for high-stakes, ambiguous calls — build / buy / partner, sequencing, reversible vs. one-way-door, and where to place a bet across pillars.
- Cross-thread synthesis: one coherent strategy across Consumer, Merchant, Partner, and Payments, with the conflicts surfaced before they collide in review.
- Narrative & decision support: the strategy spine — MMM narrative, FY strategy papers, the investment case — written to land with senior stakeholders.

Responsibilities

jobs.title: Technical Program Management, Model Development
jobs.description:
Overview
At Microsoft AI, we build the frontier models and products that reach millions of people, from pretraining through post-training, evaluation, and launch. Our Technical Program Managers are a centralized team, embedded deeply with the research, product, and engineering stakeholders they support, driving execution across every pillar and workstream. This role sits inside that pipeline, helping turn ambitious research into shipped, trusted systems.

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager with deep, hands-on technical program management experience to support model development at MAI. You'll partner closely with research, product, and applied science leads, bringing enough technical fluency in model training, evaluation, and infrastructure to engage credibly with researchers and engineers, and enough program rigor to keep complex, fast-moving work on track.

What You'll Do
As TPM, you will own end-to-end execution across the model development lifecycle, partnering with research and applied science leads to shape goals, priorities, and success metrics, and managing planning, milestones, dependencies, and risk across training, evaluation, and launch.

You'll be the connective tissue between research, engineering, product, and safety teams, translating fast-changing research priorities into clear plans, reasoning about trade-offs in data, compute, and evaluation methodology, and surfacing risks to leadership before they become blockers.

Responsibilities
Responsibilities
- Own end-to-end execution of complex technical programs across the model development lifecycle, partnering with research and applied science leads to translate research goals into clear plans, milestones, and success metrics.
- Reason about technical trade-offs in model training, evaluation, data, and infrastructure, and coordinate across research, engineering, and product to keep training and evaluation work unblocked.
- Communicate program status, risk, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and leadership, bringing lightweight structure to fast-moving, ambiguous research work.

Qualifications
Qualifications
We know that strong candidates come from many different backgrounds and experiences. If you are excited about the role and believe you could make an impact, we encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every qualification listed below.
- Significant experience in technical program management, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional programs, ideally spanning pretraining, post-training, or evaluation.
- Technical fluency to reason about model training, evaluation methodology, data, and infrastructure trade-offs, and engage credibly with researchers and engineers.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of driving alignment and influencing without formal authority.

This role will create clarity and momentum across interconnected product, engineering, data science, research, and business workstreams, ensuring that teams operate against shared priorities and that technical investments translate into measurable customer and business outcomes.
You will establish the operating mechanisms that keep a complex, distributed program aligned and moving forward. The chosen candidate is a systems thinker who thrives in ambiguity, identifies gaps before they become blockers, and can move comfortably between technical details, product priorities, customer needs, and executive decision-making.
This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the intersection of AI innovation, customer intelligence, and product decision-making. You will help shape how Frontier Listening evolves from a collection of powerful capabilities into a cohesive, scalable product and operating system, while influencing decisions across Microsoft’s product, engineering, research, and marketing organizations.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
Integrated Program Planning: Create and maintain a single, canonical view of Frontier Listening work across full-time and partner teams, including priorities, owners, milestones, dependencies, risks, blockers, and decisions.
End-to-End Program Execution: Translate product strategy into actionable plans, sequence work across multiple technical workstreams, drive commitments, and ensure consistent progress toward measurable outcomes.

You will operate in an environment of significant scale and ambiguity, bringing clarity, alignment, and operational excellence to deliver consistently and responsibly for customers worldwide. You will work closely with a key external partner and internal Microsoft stakeholders across multiple organizations to drive synchronized delivery, readiness, and customer success. jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager / FDE
jobs.description:
Overview
The Microsoft Business Operation - Frontier AI Team 's mission is to agentify and automate Microsoft's business processes, putting the latest AI capabilities to work inside Microsoft as Customer Zero. We partner directly with business teams to rethink how work gets done - building agents, applications, and automations that reduce manual effort, simplify complexity, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
We are looking for a US-based  Senior Technical Program Manager / FDE  who can operate as a full-stack AI builder across Power Platform, Microsoft 365, GitHub, Copilot, Copilot Studio, and emerging AI development tools. This is a hands-on builder role for someone who enjoys working directly with business stakeholders, understanding real workflows, challenging assumptions, and rapidly turning ambiguous problems into production-ready solutions.
The candidate brings a learn-it-all mindset, strong technical judgment, product intuition, and the ability to move fluidly from discovery to prototype to deployed solution. This person should be comfortable with AI-assisted development and "vibe coding" - using tools such as GitHub Copilot, GitHub CLI, Copilot, Copilot Studio, and related platforms to accelerate solution development while still owning quality, architecture, reliability, and business impact.
This role is for a product-minded technical builder - someone with a Technical Product Management, Technical Program Management, Forward Deployed Engineering, or full-stack solution-building background who loves using AI tools to turn ideas into working products. The candidate will be comfortable moving from ambiguous business problem to prototype to production launch, owning the solution end to end rather than handing it off after discovery or design.
Success in this role requires both technical depth and product judgment: the ability to understand stakeholder needs, make pragmatic architecture decisions, build quickly, validate with users, operationalize responsibly, and measure whether the solution changes how work gets done.
Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We foster a culture of growth, innovation, collaboration, respect, integrity, and accountability where everyone can thrive.

Responsibilities
- Build end-to-end AI and automation solutions. Design, prototype, build, test, deploy, and iterate solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Dataverse, Microsoft 365 extensibility, GitHub Copilot, GitHub CLI, Azure AI capabilities, APIs, connectors, and code where needed.
- Work directly with business teams. Partner with stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, operational constraints, and success measures. Translate ambiguous business needs into clear solution designs, delivery plans, and working products.
- Reimagine business processes. Go beyond automating existing steps. Identify opportunities to simplify, redesign, agentify, or eliminate work using AI, automation, and modern application patterns.
- Prototype quickly and responsibly. Use AI-assisted development tools and rapid experimentation to test ideas, validate feasibility, and demonstrate value early, while maintaining a path to secure, reliable, and maintainable production solutions.

Overview
Join Microsoft Ads as a Principal Technical Program Manager and help shape the systems behind ad delivery at global scale. Ads is a demanding and rewarding engineering domain, with high query volume, tight latency requirements, massive compute and data footprints, and a direct path from engineering improvements to measurable customer and business impact.
A major initial focus for this role will be ads serving runtime and compute-intensive systems, including GPU/CPU inference performance and efficiency. The role also spans the broader Data, Platform and Tools charter across online and offline ads systems, experimentation, metrics, data platforms and pipelines, capacity, developer tooling, and engineering efficiency. We are looking for a versatile technical leader who can quickly develop depth in critical areas, connect work across the end-to-end ads platform.
In this role, you will develop an independent technical point of view grounded in evidence. You will use product requirements, architecture, code paths, production data, logs, experiments, and system behavior to understand complex problems, test hypotheses, identify constraints and trade-offs, and help shape technical direction.
You will turn that understanding into end-to-end execution: framing problems, defining outcomes, aligning engineering and product teams, resolving technical and organizational dependencies, driving implementation and launch, measuring impact, and course-correcting when needed.
You will partner closely with engineering, product, data science, and business leaders across organizations, while identifying systemic opportunities, shaping technical and program direction across teams, and raising the bar for how complex technical initiatives are structured and executed.
Success requires strong technical judgment, curiosity, clear written and verbal communication, ownership, and the ability to earn influence through depth, evidence, and consistent delivery. You are not expected to own every line of production code, but you are expected to understand complex systems end to end, independently find answers, connect decisions across components, challenge assumptions credibly, and drive critical initiatives through to measurable outcomes.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
* Define and drive the vision, strategy, and measurable outcomes for complex technical programs across the Data, Platform and Tools space.
* Drive improvements in performance, reliability, scalability, capacity, cost efficiency, and operational readiness of high-scale production systems.
* Develop end-to-end understanding across services and online/offline components by reviewing architecture and code paths, analyzing production data and logs, evaluating experiments, and testing hypotheses.
* Form an evidence-based technical point of view, surface trade-offs, and influence engineering and product direction through depth, data, and sound judgment.
* Own complex initiatives end to end — from problem framing and solution definition through alignment, execution, rollout, measurement, and course correction — with accountability for outcomes.

Microsoft Quantum team is dedicated to developing the first scalable, fault-tolerant quantum computer and is leading progress in areas ranging from quantum hardware and error correction to comprehensive integration with Azure. Our team comprises an accomplished and diverse international team focused on constructing a scalable quantum computing system. Our full-stack strategy encompasses breakthrough developments, spanning the physics of quantum devices to scalable readout and control infrastructures powered by cryo-electronics. The Microsoft Quantum program aims to transform the future of computing and tackle challenges that are currently beyond reach. We are entering a pivotal phase of accelerated growth in quantum computing, and this position presents a unique opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a transformative technology.

As the Principal Technical Program Manager (Quantum Hardware) , you will play a critical leadership role in advancing the development of Microsoft's quantum hardware infrastructure. You will orchestrate cross-functional engineering initiatives, shape the direction of cutting-edge device research and development, and ensure robust execution across internal and external partners, all while aligning to Microsoft's core values of growth mindset, innovation, and inclusion. You are a deeply experienced technical program manager with a dedicated passion for customer focused solutions, insight and industry knowledge to envision and implement future technical solutions that will manage and optimize our scalable Quantum solution for our 1st Party customers.

This is a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of quantum hardware innovation. You will collaborate with leading physicists, quantum theorists, quantum experimentalists, research engineers, systems engineers, technical program managers, supply chain experts, cloud architects, and external partners to accelerate the scale-up of topological qubits and quantum systems that unlock unprecedented scientific and business value. If you are energized by complex program management challenges, thrive in ambiguity, and have a passion for foundational technologies that redefine what's possible, we invite you to join us and help shape the future of quantum computing.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

- Readiness recommendations are delivered ahead of key decision points with clear evidence, ownership, confidence, remaining risks, and recommended next actions.
- OEM, silicon, engineering, lab, SelfHost, and business stakeholders understand their roles and decision rights and have confidence in a consistent, evidence-based readiness process.

Partner with MS Security and CELA to validate post close security posture and compliance readiness.

* Build Knowledge, Playbooks, and Best Practices : Capture lessons learned to strengthen MAVS Tech playbooks, paved paths, and integration frameworks. Standardize templates, tools, and knowledge artifacts to reduce reinvention across deals. Scale organizational capability by improving repeatability, visibility, and planning readiness.

* Drive Innovation and AI Enabled Transformation : Champion AI first workflows that automate diligence, improve decision quality, and reduce cycle time. jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, HPC
jobs.description:
Overview
At Microsoft AI, we build the frontier models and products that reach millions of people, from pretraining through post-training, evaluation, and launch. The infrastructure behind this work operates at massive scale, and its reliability, availability, and operational readiness are critical to keeping researchers and engineers productive.
We are looking for a Technical Program Manager, HPC to drive the operational health and reliability of the high-performance computing infrastructure supporting Microsoft AI. You will partner closely with HPC engineering, platform, networking, storage, capacity, datacenter, and Azure teams to ensure production clusters are healthy, available, and ready to support demanding AI workloads.
This role sits at the intersection of HPC infrastructure, production operations, reliability, and technical program management . You will establish the operating mechanisms that identify problems early, coordinate rapid recovery when incidents occur, drive systemic fixes, and ensure service commitments are consistently met.
You will need enough technical depth to engage credibly on cluster health, compute, networking, storage, schedulers and infrastructure dependencies, combined with the program leadership needed to coordinate complex issues across organizational boundaries.

What You'll Do
As the HPC Production Support TPM, you will own the operating rhythm and cross-functional execution required to maintain healthy, reliable HPC clusters.
You will drive a comprehensive view of fleet and cluster health, bringing together operational signals, incidents, Nodes-In-Service and Racks-In-Service, infrastructure risks, dependencies, and service-level objectives to help teams prioritize the issues that have the greatest impact on production.
When critical incidents occur, you will help drive coordinated response across HPC and Azure teams, ensuring clear ownership, rapid escalation, effective stakeholder communication, and follow-through from mitigation through root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
Beyond individual incidents, you will identify recurring reliability patterns and translate them into durable engineering and operational improvements. You will build a strong network across Azure’s HPC, networking, storage, capacity, datacenter, and other partner teams so that dependencies are understood, escalation paths are established, and SLAs and SLOs can be consistently met.

Responsibilities
- Own end-to-end programs for HPC production health and operational readiness , driving cluster availability, reliability, and service performance.

- Establish operating mechanisms for cluster health , including SLA/SLO reviews, NIS/RIS tracking, incident trends, risks, dependencies, and corrective actions.

- Drive critical incident management , coordinating triage, escalation, mitigation, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis, and follow-through across HPC and Azure teams.

- Identify systemic reliability issues using operational signals and incident patterns, and partner with engineering teams to drive durable improvements.

- Build strong cross-functional partnerships across Azure compute, networking, storage, capacity, datacenter, and platform teams to resolve dependencies and establish effective escalation paths.

- Define and track operational metrics and dashboards that provide actionable visibility into cluster health, availability, incidents, risks, and SLA/SLO performance.

- Proactively manage production risks and dependencies , surfacing issues to engineering and leadership before they become critical blockers.

- Drive alignment without formal authority , connecting engineering and service owners around shared reliability goals and accountable execution.

- Communicate production health, major incidents, risks, and trade-offs to leadership with clear ownership and action plans.

Qualifications
- Significant experience in technical program management, infrastructure engineering, production operations, site reliability, or large-scale distributed systems .

- Demonstrated experience delivering complex, cross-functional programs spanning multiple engineering organizations.

- Technical fluency in large-scale infrastructure, including areas such as HPC, compute, accelerators, networking, storage, schedulers, capacity, telemetry, or distributed systems .

- Experience driving production incident management , including escalation, mitigation, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.

- Experience working with SLAs, SLOs, availability metrics, and production-health indicators .

- Ability to use operational data and incident trends to identify systemic problems and drive reliability improvements.

- Strong ability to build relationships and influence engineering teams across organizational boundaries.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues into clear risks, decisions, and actions.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience supporting GPU or accelerator-based HPC/AI infrastructure at scale.

- Experience with cloud infrastructure spanning compute, networking, storage, capacity, or datacenter operations .

- Experience establishing reliability programs, operational scorecards, health dashboards, or incident-management mechanisms for large infrastructure environments.
